lines.text: AUTHORS
HafsaAkhtar
Hafsa Akhtar is a senior Cambridge teacher with MPhil and dual Master degrees in Pakistan Studies
and Peace &Conflict Studies.She has received President Gold Medal from National Defense
University Islamabad. She holds international professional credentials from the University of
Curriculum Expert of History and Olevel Pakistan Studies,Exam Paper Setter,and HOD in The City
School System. Her noteworthy contributions to education include the development of Social
Studies Curriculum documentfor secondary classes, which was implemented in Pakistan's The City
SchoolSystem.She participated in thedevelopment and reviewoftheHistory Curriculum document
and authored History textbooks for Grades 6 and 7 published by NBF Islamabad.
SuhailBinAziz
Suhail Bin Azizis an educational professionalfrom Quetta with22years ofexperience.Afterreceiving
University of Oxford. He joined Education Department as a lecturer in the year 2000 and got
promoted as Assistant Professor in 2009. He also served Ministry of Federal Education Islamabad,
whereheplayed importantroleinnationalassessments,revisionofcurriculum,anddevelopmentof
textbooks.He is a Gold Medallist of International Teaching Contest in 2013. As a Teacher Trainer, he
got certification from Arizona State University. Later, he trained more than 50o0 teachers for
Paper Marking.and Life Skills Based Education.He is an author of five textbooks and a reviewer of
several books on various topics.He is also a translator of seven books on differenttopics. Mr.Suhail
hasauthoredthistextbookonvoluntarybasis.
Email:suhail_aziz@hotmail.com
TahirMehmood
Tahir Mehmood is an AssistantProfessor in Federal College of Education, Islamabad having M.Phill
in Education and Master's degrees in Economics and Pakistan Studies.He has accumulated more
than 30 years teaching experience with different educational setups in Pakistan.He is a national level
teacher trainer who conducted several trainings both in public and private sector. As a curriculum
expert and instructional material developer hehas collaborated with renowned international and
national organizations.As an assessment expert, he worked with AKU-IED and NEAS in several
different levels.Previously,he has authored SNC based textbooks of General Knowledge grade I-ll
published byNBF and implemented in ICT and other provinces of Pakistan.
